limitations: Client/server/sampler share the process and cgroup; prefixes are shared across clients.
Uniform padded PNG and alternating fixtures do not cover every codec/image shape.
Direct HTTP/1 does not establish reverse-proxy, TLS or HTTP/2 buffering.
CPU overlapped routine QA; OpenVINO started as QA finished. No comparative speed claim.
Native cgroup v1; no kernel PID lifetime peak. Shared page charging can lower cgroup usage relative to RSS.
Pre-EOF cancellation does not exercise canceled dispatched native work; existing mixed/detached probes cover that contract.
CUDA sockets, Intel GPU and other target hardware remain separate gates.
